content.short: Notional is the leading fixed rate, fixed term borrowing and lending protocol on Ethereum.
content.description: Notional is the first decentralized, Ethereum-based protocol for borrowing and lending at fixed rates and fixed terms. Variable-rate lending narrows DeFi to a small slice of the crypto lending market because uncertain interest leaves lenders and borrowers without certainty. Notional builds a genuine market for lenders and borrowers, democratizing access for individuals, business owners, and institutional investors, and it enables leveraged vaults to amplify yield strategies.
